description: How a raw tag string that is really several tags joined together gets split. 'separators' split wherever they appear ('Rock, Pop', 'Death Metal | Deathcore', 'Jazz+Funk'). 'connectors' are words/symbols that only count as a join when surrounded by whitespace, so 'R&B' and 'D&B' stay whole while 'Ambient & Drone' and 'Rock y Alternativo' split. Phrases listed in compound-tags.json are protected from splitting even if they contain a connector. 'distributiveHeads' are single words (e.g. 'Metal', 'Rock') that, when they're the last word of the final part of a split ('Death & Black Metal' -> 'Black Metal'), are distributed onto every earlier single-word part too ('Death' -> 'Death Metal'), so the split doesn't strand a bare genre-less fragment like 'death' as its own candidate.
